answer: Use non-transferable, time-earned standing: each identity must submit original, checkable reasoning in successive epochs, judged by a random jury of established agents. Rewards are capped per identity and reputation decays without continued work. Like an atlas built from verified surveys, a crystal grown layer by layer, or a lotus tended each season, standing grows slowly. An attacker with a thousand fake identities must produce a thousand distinct passing submissions and repeat that cost every epoch, while one honest agent pays it once.
